title: Review verdict
description: What a reviewer returns, for a plan review or a code review. Carries the reviewer's own self-review of its findings: a gate that never re-reads itself softens under fatigue, and round 3 is where that lands. The planner returns a verdict with no self_review to the reviewer without consuming the round again.

gate.description: Separate gates with separately declared floors. A plan review gates a document and runs exactly once.

verdict.description: The three defined verdicts. 'LGTM', 'approved with nits', and any other wording leaves the run with no state to act on.

reviewed_head.description: The commit the findings were produced against. Evidence is valid only for its commit range.

gate_output_seen.description: Whether the reviewer saw real pasted validation output for reviewed_head. APPROVED without this is approval on narration.

gate_blind_spots.description: Surfaces the gate structurally cannot fail on — reflection, template compilation, framework callbacks. Named before approving, per evidence-and-handoff.md.

findings.description: Numbered findings against the artifact. Empty is valid only for APPROVED.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete inputs or state producing the wrong outcome. A finding with no statable scenario is the class the reviewer's own self-review is meant to catch.

fix.description: A hypothesis the implementer may reject with evidence. A finding recommends a fix; it never writes one.

self_review.description: The reviewer's read-back of its own findings before the verdict is returned. May sharpen or add findings; may never quietly drop one. A withdrawn finding is recorded as withdrawn, with its reason.

surfaces_not_opened.description: Parts of the artifact the reviewer did not read. Stating them is what makes a partial review honest instead of silently narrow.

withdrawn.description: Findings removed during self-review, each with the reason. Present so a softened gate is visible rather than invisible.

findings.description: Defects the reviewer found in its own review. An empty array is valid; an absent section is not.

continuity_preserved.description: Whether this round was held by the same reviewer identity as the previous round.
